title: W118 Work-specific Task Register — Sandbox/GitHub Dual Closed Loops
model: W118 Work-level planning Task Register modeled on W70 DOC-093. It is not a runtime Core Task/Assignment database; Core :8000 is the sole runtime Task/Event authority.
rules: One canonical Work-level planning Task Register for W118; Sandbox is its operational project-planning authority.
This register tracks W118 implementation tasks and Work Package progress; it is not the runtime Core Task/Assignment/Event store.
Core :8000 is the sole canonical runtime Task/Assignment/Event authority; W102 owns Agent Loop policy; W12 owns execution/GitHub/CI bridge.
GitHub Issue mirror is generated from a normalized Core Task snapshot, not directly from this planning register.
execution_mode is a Work-level implementation authorization classification, not a runtime Agent Assignment state.
Owner-directed build tasks require owner_directive_ref; no Agent principal/ACK is fabricated.
Do not create a local Task database, dispatcher, event queue, event bus, execution host or CI engine in W118.

tasks.objective: Normalize an approved Core :8000 Task snapshot into a read-only GitHub-facing projection; do not create local runtime Task state.
inputs: Core :8000 owner-provided API schema and field map
tasks.deliverable: Core Task projection DTO and explicit field-map adapter

acceptance_criteria.description: Adapter requires an explicit field map approved by Core owner; it does not guess Core field names.
Normalized projection includes Task ID, Work ID, correlation ID, status, source revision and acceptance checks.
Adapter is read-only and contains no SQLite, Task persistence, state transition engine or event store.

blockers: Core :8000 API schema/port and approved field map have not been exposed to W118.
tasks.next_action: Obtain the actual Core Task read API contract and field map; keep adapter unbound until supplied.
tasks.status_note: Stateless DTO adapter and tests created; live Core port/schema not available.
execution_steps: Bind only after Core owner supplies API schema
tasks.scope_boundary: Read-only Core Task projection; no local Task DB, Task lifecycle state machine or assignment store.
tasks.verification_method: Unit/contract tests and exact-SHA CI; runtime API readback after Core port is available.
tasks.completion_rule: Core owner-approved field map successfully reads a canonical Core Task without local persistence.

tasks.task_title: W102/Core Agent identity and Assignment integration
tasks.objective: Connect GitHub handoff/ACK observations to the existing Core/W102 identity and Assignment policy without creating a W118 Agent Registry or dispatcher.
tasks.role_name: Xu / AI-01 coordinates; Vinh owns identity authority
tasks.deliverable: Approved integration mapping for Core principal, W102 policy decision and Assignment/ACK events

acceptance_criteria.description: W118 never treats GitHub login, label or comment as a verified Agent principal.
Assignment creation and ACK verification are delegated to Core/W102.
No W118 Agent Registry, dispatcher or assignment database exists.

blockers: Core identity/Assignment API and verified runtime principal are not exposed to W118.
tasks.next_action: Wait for Core/W102 owner to expose approved identity/Assignment port and provide one verified principal test fixture.
tasks.status_note: GitHub ACK comments are now observation-only; no local authorization or ACK state mutation.
tasks.scope_boundary: Reuse Core/W102/W01/W02/W22/W52; do not build another registry, dispatcher or event bus.
tasks.verification_method: Positive/negative integration tests using Core-owned principal fixtures.
tasks.completion_rule: A real Core/W102 Assignment and ACK round-trip succeeds with verified principal and no W118-owned state.

tasks.objective: Bind W118 Work Authority to existing W12 WEE, GitHub Gateway and CIAdapter and W13 Execution Host.
tasks.deliverable: W118 Work Authority adapter and verified W12/W13 execution integration

acceptance_criteria.description: W118 supplies repository, branch, base SHA, workspace and test entrypoint through the W12 Work Authority contract.
All execution occurs on W12/W13 host; W118 creates no local execution host or Git Gateway.
Commit/push and CI actions are authorized by Core/W12 policy and read back from GitHub.

blockers: W12 reports real execution host/CI adapter unavailable or not exposed in current ROOM-HOP context.
tasks.next_action: Obtain W12/W13 service endpoint and Work Authority schema; do not implement a parallel executor.
tasks.status_note: W118 Sandbox MCP currently exposes file operations only; no code execution command available.
tasks.scope_boundary: Reuse W12/W13 only; no W118 subprocess runner, Git gateway, CI engine or new port.
tasks.verification_method: W12/W13 runtime E2E with exact source SHA and host evidence.
tasks.completion_rule: A Core-authorized Task executes and pushes through W12/W13 with exact SHA and evidence.

tasks.task_title: Core Task to GitHub Issue and source binding
tasks.objective: Mirror a normalized Core Task snapshot to a GitHub Issue and validate Task-scoped branch/commit/push binding.
inputs: GitHub Issues and push payload contract
tasks.deliverable: Core Task Issue projection adapter and source binding validator

acceptance_criteria.description: Issue body marker and metadata are derived from a Core Task snapshot, not W118 local Task state.
Issue create/update requires Core per-Task lock and exact readback.
Task branch and every commit bind the same Work/Task/Issue IDs and exact SHA.

blockers: Core API field map/lock lease and live GitHub token are not exposed; task-scoped push has not run.
tasks.next_action: Finish adapter tests, then bind Core field map and lock lease before live Issue create/readback.
tasks.status_note: Stateless Core projection and Issue adapter contracts implemented; live Core/GitHub integration pending.
tasks.scope_boundary: No local Task DB; GitHub Issue is a mirror of Core; no Assignee, close, merge or release mutation.
tasks.verification_method: Unit/contract tests, Core lock fixture, GitHub API readback and exact SHA push test.
tasks.completion_rule: One Core Task has one verified GitHub Issue and exact task-scoped branch/commit binding.

tasks.task_title: Stateless GitHub webhook verifier and Core event adapter
tasks.objective: Verify GitHub webhook signature/envelope and normalize push/CI/Issue observations into Core event intents without local inbox or event persistence.
tasks.deliverable: HMAC verifier and stateless GitHub-to-Core event adapter

acceptance_criteria.description: HMAC, repository/event allowlist, delivery UUID and payload size are validated.
Push/CI events bind to Core Task and exact SHA; out-of-order CI is DEFERRED.
Adapter has no local queue, inbox database, event ID/sequence assignment or Task state mutation.

blockers: Core event port is not exposed; real GitHub webhook secret/TLS endpoint is not configured.
tasks.next_action: Finish stateless adapter tests; bind to the existing Core event ingress once Core owner exposes the port.
tasks.status_note: Verifier/event-intent adapter replaces local webhook inbox and reconciler; no durable W118 event store.
execution_steps: Test duplicate and out-of-order handling at Core
tasks.scope_boundary: No W118 event bus, queue, inbox DB, sequence generator or local persistence.
tasks.verification_method: Unit/contract tests and Core event port integration test.
tasks.completion_rule: Real GitHub event is verified, normalized and persisted by Core with idempotent exact Task binding.

KPI values trace to source Task/evidence IDs and freshness timestamps.

tasks.next_action: Prepare a read-only projection mapping and request/await W70 owner approval before integration.
tasks.status_note: No W70 schema or dashboard writes have been made.

tasks.verification_method: Schema validation, source-to-projection parity, freshness and read-only tests.
tasks.completion_rule: W70 owner approves mapping and read-only projection passes all parity/freshness tests.
